python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0037.png"))
# Find bottle floor contact (bottom row of blue pixels)
blue_mask = (img[:, :, 2] > 150) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50)
v_indices, u_indices = np.where(blue_mask)
print(f"obs_0037 bottle: u from {u_indices.min()} to {u_indices.max()}, v from {v_indices.min()} to {v_indices.max()}")
v_contact = v_indices.max()
u_center = (u_indices.min() + u_indices.max()) / 2.0
print(f"Bottom contact: v={v_contact}, u_center={u_center}")

# Pinhole projection for contact:
f, H = 256.0, 1.55
Zc = f * H / (v_contact - 256.0)
Xc = (u_center - 256.0) * H / (v_contact - 256.0)
print(f"Camera frame: Zc={Zc:.3f}, Xc={Xc:.3f}")
# In frame 37: xc=0.567, yc=3.982, th=90 deg (+x front, -y right)
Xw = 0.567 + Zc
Yw = 3.982 - Xc
print(f"World: Xw={Xw:.3f}, Yw={Yw:.3f}")
'
